<thought>We need to find a retrosynthetic template that, when applied to the target molecule (likely a cinnamic acid derivative), reproduces the Doebner modification. Since the exact SMILES of the target isn’t provided, we’ll assume a generic α,β‑unsaturated carboxylic acid such as cinnamic acid (O=C(O)C=CC1=CC=CC=C1). We’ll search the template catalog for reactions that form a C=C bond and break a C‑C bond and a C‑O bond, which matches the Doebner modification. Then we’ll retrieve the first matching template and return its mapped reaction SMILES and template_id.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "O=C(O)C=CC1=CC=CC=C1",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["C-O", "C-C"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["C=C"],
    "bonds_formed": null,
    "bonds_broken": null,
    "bonds_order_changed": null,
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
